full_name: John Tasioulas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Humanities Lisa Goldberg Fellow King's College London (United Kingdom)
bio: John Tasioulas is the Yeoh Professor of Politics, Philosophy & Law and the inaugural director of the Yeoh Tiong Lay Centre for Politics, Philosophy & Law at the Dickson Poon School of Law, King’s College London. He has published extensively in moral, legal, and political philosophy, with a focus on philosophical issues in crime and punishment, human rights, and international law.
